analysis.reason: RSI 26.5로 과매도 구간 지속, MACD 히스토그램 개선에도 불구하고 추세 전환 신호 미확인. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 0.66으로 위축된 거래량은 매수세 부재 시사. 2일 전 -5.76% 급락 후 금일 -0.11% 소폭 하락으로 변동성 축소 구간 진입. 현재가 $0.14는 스윙 지지선과 일치하나, 명확한 반등 근거 부족으로 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 26.5 persists in oversold territory. Despite MACD histogram improvement, a clear trend reversal signal is unconfirmed. Volume ratio at 0.66 of the 5-day average indicates subdued trading, suggesting a lack of buying pressure. Following a sharp -5.76% drop two days ago, today's -0.11% decline shows reduced volatility. The current price of $0.14 aligns with the swing support level, but insufficient evidence for a rebound warrants a wait-and-see approach.

[모멘텀 지표]

[지지·저항 구조]

· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (5일 저가 $0.13, 20일 저가 $0.13): 횡보 패턴 확인
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.66) + 움직임의 신뢰도 위축
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 명확한 반등 근거 부재로 관망 유지 조건
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.14) vs SMA5/20/50 ($0.15/$0.16/$0.19): indicates short-to-mid-term trend below moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($0.21/$0.20): suggests a weak long-term trend.
· 52-week position (2.9%) + current price near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (29.9→26.5) + persistent oversold condition + maintaining downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0015→-0.0006) + improving signal + trend reversal unconfirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $0.13) + interpreting proximity to the lower band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level ($0.14) + basis (coincides with current price).
· Swing resistance level ($0.18) + potential approach to the middle band upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low $0.13, 20-day low $0.13): confirms sideways pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.66) + reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + maintaining a wait-and-see stance due to lack of clear rebound evidence.
